note: Dimension provides three calculated field types: length_field_type (component length), area_field_type (width, height), volume_field_type (length, width, height). Each stores a computed 'value' = product of (component x its factor) rounded to value_scale. Per-component FieldConfig settings are factor/min/max/prefix/suffix; storage settings are <key>_precision/<key>_scale. Medium cases read known field settings (an area field's width factor; a length field's min). Hard cases create a namespaced area field and a length field with a factor of 10. All fields are namespaced field_dim_* and removed by cleanup/reset. No drush cr (config/entity reads are live) to avoid an unrelated shared-site group-module cache-rebuild fault.

evals.prompt: What field types does the Drupal 'dimension' module provide, and what does each measure?
evals.expected_output: Three calculated field types: length_field_type (length), area_field_type (width x height), and volume_field_type (length x width x height).

evals.prompt: In the dimension module, how is the stored dimension value of an Area field computed from what the editor enters?
evals.expected_output: In preSave() the value is the product of each component times its configurable factor, rounded to value_scale: for Area, value = width x width.factor x height x height.factor. Volume multiplies all three components; Length is length x length.factor.

evals.prompt: Besides showing the computed total, how can the dimension module display the individual width/height components of an Area field, and what formatter does that?
evals.expected_output: Use the 'Dimension: Area Components' formatter (area_components_field_formatter), which renders the raw components via the area-components template as '{{ width }} x {{ height }}'. The plain area_field_formatter instead shows the computed value (with the value prefix/suffix).

evals.prompt: The Article content type has a dimension Area field named field_dim_known_area. Inspect its live field configuration and state the factor that is applied to the Width component.
evals.expected_output: The Width component's factor is 2, in FieldConfig node.article.field_dim_known_area settings.width.factor.

evals.prompt: The Article content type has a dimension Length field named field_dim_known_len with a minimum value constraint configured. Inspect the live field configuration and state the minimum allowed length.
evals.expected_output: The Length component's min is 5, in FieldConfig node.article.field_dim_known_len settings.length.min.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, add a dimension Area field (the area_field_type) named field_dim_area to the Article content type. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A field storage node.field_dim_area of type area_field_type exists and is attached to the article bundle.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, add a dimension Length field (length_field_type) named field_dim_length to the Article content type, configured so the entered length is multiplied by a factor of 10 when the dimension value is calculated (e.g. converting cm to mm). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A length_field_type field node.article.field_dim_length exists and its field settings set the length component's factor to 10 (settings.length.factor = 10).
